description: This file contains server-side logic for an ASP.NET Web Forms page that provides an authorization method for embedding dashboards. It includes a web method to handle authorization requests, signature generation for security, and a page load event handler.

classes.name: _Default
classes.description: Code-behind class for the default ASP.NET Web Forms page, includes web methods and event handlers.

methods.name: AuthorizationServer
methods.description: Static web method that constructs an embed authorization URL, signs it, performs an HTTP GET request, and returns the response as JSON.

methods.name: GetSignatureUrl
methods.description: Generates a HMAC-SHA256 signature for a given message using a secret key.
